text: First National Bank - a division of FirstRand Bank Limited.
short: FNB is a division of FirstRand Bank Limited.

source.name: FirstRand Bank Limited Annual Report 2023 (PDF)
source.quote: The bank has three major divisions which are separately branded: First National Bank (FNB), WesBank and Rand Merchant Bank (RMB).

additionalSources.name: FirstRand Limited Group Annual Financial Statements 2025 (PDF)
additionalSources.quote: FirstRand Limited is the holding company of the FirstRand group of companies. FirstRand’s portfolio of integrated financial services businesses comprises FNB, RMB, WesBank and Aldermore
